title: STATE My Path: How to Speak Persuasively, Not Abrasively
heading: Chapter 07
chapterLocalFacts: STATE means Share your facts, Tell your story, Ask for others' paths, Talk tentatively, and Encourage testing.
The sequence matters because people often skip facts or present story as fact.
Tentative language is used to keep the other person in dialogue, not to weaken the message.
The framework fails when the speaker collapses at the first pushback.
bridgeForward: Chapter 8 teaches the reverse skill: drawing other people out when they clam up or blow up.
